stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 28 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G017】名词性从句与同位语从句（the claim/assumption/fact that...）；【G022】并列、从属、平行结构（Parallelism）与对比对称性。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP021】具身智能（Embodied AI）与机器人：空间表征、轨迹跟踪与物理约束，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 名词性从句与同位语从句（the claim/assumption/fact that...）
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 同位语从句（the claim/assumption/hypothesis/notion/contention/fact that + 完整句）用于精确展开抽象学术名词的内涵；介词后若需接完整陈述句，必须借助 the fact that 或 in that。
rules: 同位语从句连接词 that 不作成分但不可省略，也不可换为 which（The contention that all data are interchangeable needs justification）。
介词（account for, despite, due to, stem from）不能直接接 that 从句，必须用 account for the fact that / despite the fact that / stem from the fact that。
examples: The model cannot account for the fact that rates differ across sites.
The scheme was adopted despite the fact that it was costly.
The discrepancy stems from the fact that the samples differ.
common_errors: 介词直接接 that 从句：*despite that it was costly / *due to that several records were missing。

grammar_instruction.name: 并列、从属、平行结构（Parallelism）与对比对称性
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 由 and, or, rather than, as opposed to, as well as, both... and... 连接的成分必须在词性、句法层级与逻辑角色上严格平行。
rules: 对比排除连接词（rather than, as opposed to）两侧结构必须平行：reporting observed values as opposed to predictions；measured an association rather than a causal effect。
分别对应结构（A and B ... X and Y, respectively）两侧元素个数与顺序必须严格一一对应。
examples: The table reports observed values as opposed to predictions.
The symbols x and y denote temperature and demand, respectively.
common_errors: 两侧词性不对称：*combines quantitative measurements with interviewing participants（名词短语与动名词不对称）。

grammar_instruction.name: 学术段落逻辑架构：主题句—机制解释—实证/实例支撑—范围限定
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 无论是顶会论文 Discussion 还是六级/雅思托福主体段，高质量段落都必须具备“清晰主题句（Topic Sentence）-> 作用机制或理论解释（Mechanism/Warrant）-> 具体数据或实例（Concrete Evidence/Instance）-> 边界限定（Qualification）”四层逻辑，拒绝仅靠连接词填空。
rules: 防范逻辑跳跃（Logical Leap）：从“某现象存在或某指标提升”到“应全面推广某政策/模型”之间，必须补充成本、可行性（feasibility）或分布偏移（distribution shift）的权衡（trade-off）。
正确区分对比连接词：on the contrary 仅用于否定刚提及的命题（“恰恰相反”），而对比两个不同群体的表现必须用 by contrast / in contrast / on the other hand。
examples: The report claims that every village was sampled. On the contrary, remote villages were excluded.
Urban use increased; by contrast, rural use remained stable.
common_errors: 把 on the contrary 误当作 on the other hand / by contrast 使用。
段落只有空洞观点句和夸张形容词，缺乏具体机制解释与可核验实例。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 具身智能（Embodied AI）与机器人：空间表征、轨迹跟踪与物理约束
expression_pattern_instruction.template: To bridge the discrepancy between simulation and real-world deployment, the policy enforces [physical/monotonicity constraints] while adapting to [sensor noise / external perturbations].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于具身智能、机器人控制与视觉导航写作，准确表达仿真到真实迁移（sim-to-real）、空间方位（spatial orientation）与速度/运动学约束。
examples: The optimization procedure enforces a non-negativity constraint on the weights while tracking the trajectory.
The sensitivity analysis examines the effect of a small perturbation to the input sensor readings.
common_errors: 把仿真器（simulation）中的理想合成观测（synthetic data）直接等同于真实物理传感器的含噪观测。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）、研究陈述（SoP）与审稿回复（Rebuttal）的自然衔接
expression_pattern_instruction.template: In response to the reviewer's question regarding [X], we have clarified [Y] and added an experiment on [Z]; as this slide/table shows, the conclusion remains robust.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于国际会议口头报告、博士/教职申请研究陈述（Research Statement）及同行评审回复，做到礼貌、直接、有理有据。
examples: I would like to begin by explaining the sampling procedure, and I will allow time for questions at the end.
The revision addresses the limitation explicitly and incorporates feedback from the pilot evaluation.
common_errors: 在 Rebuttal 中情绪化反驳（hostile remarks）或回避审稿人指出的核心假设缺陷。
